answer: Before earning, a newcomer must pass a 30-day dune-anchored VDF proof: a public, non-parallelizable chain of dated hashes. Each hash sits in the shared quill pool and must be verified by three distinct attesters before the prism unlocks. A 1,000-clone fleet means 1,000 independent 14-day VDF runs with no parallel shortcut; the public VDF registry exposes every cluster that shares hardware or IP history. Honest cost: one VDF + one attestation set per identity, reusable; attacker cost: N VDFs + N attesters, with the quill pool making every cluster's origin traceable on-chain.
